biggest_catch: Only the first $350 is quick — the remaining $200 requires keeping a $500+/month direct deposit running for 12 and 24 months, so the full $550 takes two years.
catches: The full $550 is tiered: $350 for the first qualifying direct deposit, then $100 more after 12 consecutive months of $500+/month direct deposits, and $100 more after 24 consecutive months — two years for the full amount.
You must open a Free, Smart, or Student Checking account between February 2, 2026 and December 31, 2026.
The first qualifying direct deposit ($500+) must post within 90 days of account opening; each bonus pays within 60 days of the qualifying event.
You must not have an existing FourLeaf checking account as primary holder and must never have received a FourLeaf checking bonus before.
FourLeaf membership is required (subject to approval; requires opening and maintaining a $5 savings account).
If a qualifying direct deposit fails to post in any month after the initial one, you lose the second and third bonuses.
This is FourLeaf Federal Credit Union (fourleaffcu.com, formerly Bethpage FCU — bethpagefcu.com now serves the same pages) — the correct institution.

payout_quote: First, earn $350 when you: open a new eligible FourLeaf Free Checking Account by 12/31/2026; set up a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening; receive $350 bonus in your account within 60 days of your initial qualifying direct deposit. Then, earn up to an additional two $100 bonuses: within 60 days of your one year direct deposit anniversary you can receive $100 as long as you maintain a monthly recurring direct deposit of $500 or more for 12 consecutive months; within 60 days of your two year direct deposit anniversary an additional $100 for 24 consecutive months.

steps: Join FourLeaf FCU (membership requires approval and a $5 savings account).
Open a new Free, Smart, or Student Checking account by December 31, 2026.
Set up a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more and have it post within 90 days of account opening — the $350 bonus lands within 60 days of that deposit.
Keep a monthly recurring direct deposit of $500 or more posting every month: $100 pays within 60 days of the one-year direct-deposit anniversary.
Keep the $500+/month direct deposits posting through the two-year anniversary for the final $100.
timing: $350 within 60 days of the initial qualifying direct deposit; $100 within 60 days of the one-year direct-deposit anniversary; $100 within 60 days of the two-year anniversary.
